entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Muslim League, a political institution in Bangladesh during British Raj and Bengali Nationalism (1911–1947). Grew from Curzon and Partition of Bengal 1905 and Swadeshi Movement. Led to the emergence of Partition of India creates East Pakistan from Muslim-majority Bengal and Bengal Famine of 1943 kills approximately 3 million people.
